metadata.name: Neko Project II Kai
metadata.summary: Emulate NEC PC-9801 and PC-9821 series computers with extended architecture support

content.value: Neko Project II Kai is an open-source emulator for the NEC PC-9801 and PC-9821 series of Japanese personal computers. Built on SDL and modern C++, it accurately reproduces legacy x86 architecture alongside sound, display, and peripheral hardware for retrocomputing software and game preservation.
The emulator features flexible architecture configurations, extensive media emulation, and support for running as a standalone SDL application or a Libretro core across diverse operating systems.

items.value: Configurable processor cores with support for Intel 80286 and IA-32 instruction sets
Flexible disk emulation handling floppy disk images (FDD) and hard disk images (HDD)
In-emulator configuration menu for on-the-fly disk swapping via keyboard, mouse, or gamepad
Multi-platform audio and visual rendering using SDL2 and SDL2_mixer
Libretro core integration for compatibility with frontend managers like RetroArch
